fusions.name: Ley Spore Burst
fusions.desc: Looses 5 spores of raw mana at once, spread apart, each dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Mana Thorn
fusions.desc: Flicks a thorn of mana at one enemy up to 5 tiles away, dealing 4 damage, more the further it flies, up to 1.5 times, with a 30% chance to leave it [Dimmed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Forced Bloom
fusions.desc: Forces one of your other abilities into early flower, clearing its cooldown; it is chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Ley-Fed Roots
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
